shared_elements: frontal or near-frontal human body with profile elements
low-relief carving covering the whole surface
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief human figures with raised arms as the principal subject, but that is a generic correspondence: A shows a single elaborately costumed standing figure surrounded by dense curvilinear ornament, headdress volutes and glyph-like signs framed in a vertical panel, while B shows a horizontal frieze of several small, plain, active crouching/squatting figures with no ornament, costume or sign field. The compositional schemes (single frontal icon vs repeated processional figures) and the degree of decorative elaboration are quite different.
